statements.t: Given our current trajectory, we are raising the low end of our full-year revenue guidance to $25 million, while reiterating the top end of $27 million.

We expect full-year burn to land close to or slightly above the high end of our guided range, largely due to opportunistic capex purchases, with fourth-quarter burn below our year-to-date quarterly average due to revenue and margin improvements.
With $47.0 million in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities, we believe we are well funded to execute, and we expect our 2026 growth to extend into 2027."
The Company now expects full-year 2026 operating cash burn to be close to or slightly above the high end of its ($32.0) – ($36.0) million range.

The Company expects fourth quarter cash burn to be lower than the year-to-date quarterly average in the fourth quarter of 2026 due to increased revenue and gross margin to offset operating expenses in the fourth quarter compared to the first half of the year.

The Company believes its cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of $47.0 million will be sufficient to support operations, working capital and capital expenditure requirements for at least the next 12 months.

Our core AI software offerings, Palladyne IQ and SwarmOS/Palladyne Pilot, consist of full-stack, closed-loop autonomy software that is intended to enhance the functionality and operational effectiveness of third-party robotic systems across a range of applications and our proprietary UAVs.
We expect to continue commercialization efforts, internal testing and customer trials for our products through the remainder of 2026.

We intend to use our cash on hand to continue to enhance our products, conduct product development activities, pursue marketing and sales opportunities and fund operations as we seek to further commercialize and enhance and achieve revenue from our products and services.

As a result, we intend to continue monitoring our liquidity, financial and business results and outlook and market conditions, and may be opportunistic and raise capital when we consider market conditions are good or a favorable opportunity exists or when we otherwise deem it to be necessary or advisable.
We will continue to carefully evaluate our use of cash and liquidity.
The market demand for our software is unproven, and important assumptions about the characteristics of targeted markets, pricing and sales cycles may be inaccurate.

While we believe that our products will provide significant benefits and return on investment to customers, as it is a new technology, we are dependent on customers who are willing to adopt, purchase and implement new technologies and products.

The duration of government shutdowns could have a compounding effect, and the longer they continue or the more frequently they occur, the more significant the potential adverse impact may be on our anticipated revenues.

Among other things, these and similar factors can affect our ability to hire or retain qualified personnel, our labor and materials costs, the prices we charge for our products and services and the budgets of our customers and their expected return-on-investment from the purchase of our products and services.
We expect future revenue from contracts to fluctuate due to the timing of new contracts signed, contract options being exercised, and the completion of existing contracts.
We intend to take on only those product development contracts that we believe support and contribute to our product development efforts.

We believe that our cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities on hand will be sufficient to support operations, working capital and capital expenditure requirements for at least the next 12 months from the date of this Report.

We plan to use our existing capital to further commercialize and conduct sales and marketing efforts for our commercially available products and services, as well as continue product testing, debugging and stabilization efforts, conduct product development efforts for initial and updated versions of our products, and to fund purchases for our work-in-process inventory and long lead time components.

We intend to continue monitoring our liquidity, financial and business results and outlook and market conditions, and may be opportunistic and raise capital when market conditions are good or a favorable opportunity exists or we otherwise determine it to be necessary or advisable, including under our "at-the-market" equity offering programs.

Any delays in the successful further commercialization and sales of our products and services will negatively impact our ability to generate revenue, our profitability and our overall operating performance and result in the need to raise additional capital sooner than expected.

estimates.t: Our discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations are based upon our financial statements, which have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States ("GAAP").
